intro: "You Too Good." is a Horde quest offered by the Orgrimmar fishing trainer, Lumak, once an angler has surpassed ordinary training. Lumak sends his accomplished pupil to track down his human friend, Nat Pagle, camped along the remote shores of Dustwallow Marsh. It marks the transition from standard instruction to the demanding art of artisan fishing.
